framework: Aligned with the NIST AI RMF 1.0 functions (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage). Not a certification or compliance claim.
status: Agent-proposed register, version risks-4 (2026-10-15, Phase B of the final completion stage). Owners, likelihood and severity remain the agent's proposal, a working baseline rather than a validated assessment (L-D9 G1 d). risks-4 corrects the stale R-08 and R-10 plan text, adds R-08 and R-11 evidence, and records mandatory specialist reviews as structured entries. Earlier versions are kept unchanged in governance/history/. No human decision is recorded in this file: decisions live only in the database, bound to each risk's content, and decisions given for earlier content do not carry over.

scales.score: likelihood x severity; 15+ high, 8-14 medium, below 8 low

risks.title: A student in crisis is not routed to urgent guidance
risks.description: Keyword routing misses non-English, implicit or unusually phrased crisis messages.
risks.mitigation_plan: SB-04/05/06 mitigated in Phase 5. Finalization (2026-10-15): escalate-only explicit crisis lexicon for 12 languages, narrow implicit-risk warning signs, and an unsupported-language notice with 988/911; the SB-07 and SB-08 scenarios now pass and the pre-registered probes give 34/34 and 15/15 with 0/30 benign escalations. Devika's held-out check B10 (2026-10-15, 208 cases frozen before the patterns were read): first run 149/208, with explicit covered 32/36, variants 18/32, implicit English 2/14, implicit other languages 0/6, negated risk 7/12, uncovered languages 0/17 routed (notice 14/17), and 0/82 benign or ambiguous escalations. The B10 additions bring the same set to 179/208 (notice 17/17 on uncovered languages, still 0/82 escalations), but those figures are no longer held out. Still open: languages outside the lexicon (notice only), implicit wording in any language other than English, implicit English wording outside the lists (5/14 held-out cases still missed), and every term is agent-drafted. Needs Devika's routing sign-off, native-speaker and clinical review, a new held-out set written without seeing the patterns, and a human residual-risk decision.
pending_human_review: SB-07 multilingual crisis lexicon (agent-drafted; Devika's routing review and native-speaker review)
SB-08 implicit-risk warning-sign lists (agent-drafted; Devika's routing review and clinical review)
B10 lexicon, warning-sign and notice-word additions (agent-drafted at Devika's direction; native-speaker and clinical review)
language_support notice wording, including its Spanish sentence

required_specialist_reviews.description: Native-speaker review of the multilingual crisis lexicon (12 languages, including the B10 additions) and of the Spanish sentence in the language_support notice
Clinical or counseling review of the implicit-risk warning-sign lists (SB-08 and B10 additions), including the held-out cases left for clinical judgment (IE-02, IE-05, IE-06, IE-10, IE-14)

risks.title: Safety guidance is replaced or weakened by a model, planner or decline handling
risks.description: Downstream components could override a deterministic safety decision.
risks.mitigation_plan: Keep the safety stage first; keep parity and red-team safety scenarios in the release gate.

risks.title: Prompt injection causes unauthorized actions
risks.description: User text, model output or retrieved text tries to invoke privileged operations.
risks.mitigation_plan: No privileged agent tools; agent channel denied admin:*; red-team class prompt_injection 0/9.

risks.title: Poisoned or unreviewed content reaches answers
risks.description: Malicious or unreviewed pages become citations; until 2026-10-15 the C1 CLI path read KB files directly (RP-06).
risks.mitigation_plan: Governed API blocks it (retrieval poisoning 0/6). Finalization (2026-10-15): the CLI/Dispatcher path ranks only records the inventory lists with the same content hash and an eligible status, without instruction-like content, and fails closed; legacy red team RP-06 defended. Host and freshness checks stay API-only. The CLI behaviour change needs human acceptance.
pending_human_review: RP-06 legacy CLI retrieval gate (a behaviour change for the C1 CLI path)

risks.title: Outdated or unreviewed campus information
risks.description: All 7 citable KB records are baseline (no governed review) and dated 2025; hours and services may have changed.
risks.mitigation_plan: A reviewer checks each source against the official page and records approve or reject in the staff UI (specialist review SR-03); stale and baseline notices are shown until then. No source has been reviewed (0 source_reviews rows when last checked, L-D8). The crisis contact numbers in the templates were checked against the official pages on 2026-10-15 (docs/safety/crisis-routing.md section 6); that is not a review of the KB sources themselves.

required_specialist_reviews.description: Each citable baseline knowledge-base source compared with its official UMBC page by an authorized reviewer and recorded as a source review in the staff UI

risks.title: One student sees or changes another's conversation
risks.description: Broken ownership checks would disclose sensitive conversations.

risks.title: Staff account takeover or privilege escalation
risks.description: Guessing, CSRF, session reuse or forged roles grant administrative capability.
risks.mitigation_plan: No MFA in this local prototype (documented). Red-team privilege_escalation 0/9.

required_specialist_reviews.description: Independent security assessment of the deployed service (staff authentication and sessions, authorization policy, ingestion, rate limits) by someone who did not write the red-team scenarios

risks.title: Sensitive text in logs, traces or audit records
risks.description: Conversation text or identities leak into operational records.
risks.mitigation_plan: Phase 7 telemetry is implemented: JSON logs keep only allowlisted fields, spans carry route templates and no message text, identities or ids, and audit rows hash principals. Finding (2026-10-15, Phase B): uvicorn's default access log printed raw request paths, including session ids, and client addresses outside the allowlist; the app now disables it and the backend image also runs with --no-access-log. scripts/privacy_log_probe.py runs a real server with synthetic use and finds none of the message text, session id, CSRF token, cookies, staff username or password in its output. Not covered: logging by the platform outside the containers.

risks.title: Invented contact details or campus guidance
risks.description: Generated or retrieved text presents unverified phone numbers, hours or clinical advice as fact.
risks.mitigation_plan: No generated prose in answers; fake-number scenarios RP-02, RP-03, PI-09 defended.

risks.title: Model provider outage or slowness degrades the service
risks.description: Hung or failing model calls consume threads or delay answers (C1 deferral O9).
risks.mitigation_plan: Model features are off by default. A planner timeout with rule fallback, a circuit breaker and at most two in-flight model calls are implemented and tested. Phase 8 container resilience checks (unreachable and hanging model, backend and frontend interruption, crash restart) and Phase 9 kind recovery checks passed; their evidence is refreshed by the final battery. The live local-model check covers few messages and is not a load test.

risks.title: Vulnerable third-party dependencies
risks.description: Known vulnerabilities in Python or npm packages.
risks.mitigation_plan: pip-audit, npm audit, Bandit, Trivy (images and configuration) and gitleaks run in every full release battery. Readiness rules L-D13 reject release evidence older than 7 days or for another candidate, so a dependency scan counts only for the exact release candidate.

risks.title: Users mistake the prototype for an official or clinical service
risks.description: Students may rely on it for clinical or emergency help.
risks.mitigation_plan: Keep the disclaimer on every view; synthetic data only; no public deployment.

risks.title: Server-side request forgery through ingestion
risks.description: An attacker-chosen URL reaches internal services.
risks.mitigation_plan: Admin-only; allowlist and address checks; rebinding detection depends on the HTTP stack.

risks.title: Contracts and governance decisions not accepted by both humans
risks.description: Local-first decisions (workflow, contracts, policies, thresholds) were made in one operator's session and await recorded acceptance.
risks.mitigation_plan: Both humans have recorded their positions on the local-first decisions (L-D7 to L-D13), including joint acceptance of the corrected readiness rules (L-D13), which require both joint reviewers' own decisions on every risk. Still open: every risk decision entered by both in the staff UI under their bound accounts, and the publication decisions.

risks.title: Single-process limits on abuse controls and availability
risks.description: Rate limits and caches are in-memory per process; restarts reset them.
risks.mitigation_plan: Run one backend replica (Compose and kind manifests set replicas: 1 for the API) and document it.
